problem:
The function $p(x)$ is continuous over $x\in [-6,5].$ Some values of $p(x)$ are given in the table below. 

| $x$ | $-6$ | $-2$ | $5$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $p(x)$ | $4$ | $-1$ | $-3$ |

What is the smallest possible number of solutions to the equation $p(x)=2?$

The equation $p(x)=2$ has at least {{field-1}} solutions.
